interpretation_rules.rule: Do not infer root cause from graph shape/color alone; always link the interpretation to grok.json, print.txt, or probe.json.
Insecure means a proven absence of a chain of trust; it must not automatically be classified as an error.
Bogus must be treated as potential impact for validating resolvers.
Lame delegation is primarily an availability/reachability problem, not a cryptographic DNSSEC problem.
DS/RRSIG without matching DNSKEY may be part of a rollover; compare with history before declaring a definitive incident.
UDP/TCP/IPv6/PMTU problems affect DNS service health but must not by themselves turn a secure DNSSEC chain into bogus.
